title: trinia vulgaris subsp. pumila
intro: Trinia vulgaris subsp. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Carrot, is a plant species in the Apiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Trinia vulgaris subsp. pumila include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against certain microorganisms. Bioactive constituents of the plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
